text:
maya: 1am furniture question: what do you folks listen to when you're pretending you're a competent adult and assembling flatpack stuff? need ~50 minutes that keeps me steady but not hyped. also must include at least one triumphant track for 'found the extra screw' moment. :sweat_smile:

rob: you want steady momentum. playlist idea: start instrumentals, middle some funky grooves, end with celebratory pop.

ash: low-key vote for ELO's instrumentals for the final screw. nothing says victory like strings.

sara: also: consider mixing in a spoken-word short podcast episode for the 10-minute 'read the instructions' stretch so you don't overconfidently skip steps.

maya: good call. i tend to spiral into tutorial rabbit holes if there's silence.

rob: quick manual set: 1) Tycho - for steady drive 2) Khruangbin - groove 3) ELO instrumental for end 4) a 3-minute upbeat song for the extra-screw high.

spotify-bot: Suggested short playlist: "Flatpack Flow (50m)" 0 tracks0: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1exampleFlowLink

ash: throw in a 2-minute Prince clip around 42:00 for maximum flair.

maya: haha i will. can we get exact timestamps so i can set a celebratory alarm??

rob: set alarm at 48:30 for stretch/cheer. if you hit it early, celebrate early.

sara: also rename the allen key contact to 'Excalikey' and take a photo post-assembly. evidence required.

maya: renaming keyboard shortcut: done. playlist queued. podcast queued at 20:00 mark. ready to adult.

(30 minutes later)

maya: update: two extra dowels, one strip of mystery cardboard, and Excalikey did the thing. ELO at the end = cinematic.

rob: legendary. now you know the true cost of furniture ownership. :tada:

ash: photo or it didn't happen. :camera_with_flash:

maya: uploading in #random-photos in 2.

spotify-bot: reaction added :thumbsup:

maya: also left a very small screw under my couch for future me to find during spring cleaning. achievement unlocked. :medal_sports:
